credentials.title: Sdui login
credentials.description: Log in with the same credentials you use on sdui.app. The integration renews the token automatically.

data_description.slink: Part of your school login URL: https://sdui.app/<slink>/login. The full URL also works. If login fails with 'school not found', paste the address of the Sdui login page (https://iam.sdui-group.app/realms/...) instead.
data_description.user_id: Leave empty to use your own account. Parents: enter the child's id from https://sdui.app/timetable/users/<user_id>.

token.title: Manual Bearer token
token.description: Copy the Bearer token from your browser's developer tools (Network tab, Authorization header of a request to api.sdui.app). It expires and must then be replaced manually. Valid for about 5 minutes only – useful for testing only.

reauth_confirm.title: Sdui re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The login for user {user_id} is no longer valid. Enter your Sdui credentials; the token will then be renewed automatically.

data_description.slink: Part of your school login URL: https://sdui.app/<slink>/login. The full URL also works. If login fails with 'school not found', paste the address of the Sdui login page (https://iam.sdui-group.app/realms/...) instead.

select_user.title: Choose timetable
select_user.description: This account has several users (e.g. children). Whose timetable should be shown? Add the integration again for each further child.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check school, username and password (or token).
error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to Sdui or school not found. Details in the Home Assistant log.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant logs.

abort.already_configured: This Sdui account is already configured.
